body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy within ranged Weapon Range, or one unattended light object within 4 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage and pull the enemy 1 unit. An unattended object instead moves up to 2 units toward you without opposition.

surges.html: After hitting an enemy, you may move 1 unit toward it.

rider.title: Lock - Trickshot
rider.html: After a hit on a Locked enemy, you may end Lock to prevent that enemy from pushing or pulling you until the start of your next turn.
